🚀 ClovaLink | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing a secure, cost-effective, and self-hostable enterprise file management solution for businesses that require advanced features and full data control, especially those managing multiple clients or tenants.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-tenant file management • Secure APIs
📖 Summary: ClovaLink is a self-hostable, multi-tenant file management platform built with Rust and React, designed to offer enterprise-grade features at a significantly lower cost than commercial solutions. It provides secure APIs, extensible metadata, external identity provider integration, and pluggable storage backends, making it ideal for businesses seeking control over their data and compliance.
